entities.name: Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar
entities.description: A merrow schoolmaster and former ferryman on Lorwyn's Wanderwine river.

entities.name: Dugah
entities.description: Sygg's apprentice, eaten by an arbomander.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: Flamekin pilgrim who seeks passage to Kinsbaile.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Elf who seeks passage to the Murmuring Bosk.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Secretly a creation of Oona; later keeps the Crescent.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: Kithkin hero who attacks Ashling and takes the Crescent.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Faerie queen who intervenes to take Ashling's power.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: Treefolk sage who sends Rhys to the Bosk.

entities.name: Reejerey Kasella
entities.description: Leader of the Paupurfylln school, Sygg's former mate.

entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: Faerie clique that tracked Ashling and abducted Maralen.

entities.name: Crescent of Morningtide
entities.description: Artifact Sygg possessed as Heir to Morningtide.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Event that turned Lorwyn into Shadowmoor.

events.summary: An arbomander attacks Sygg's ferry, knocking him out and eating Dugah; the faeries save the passengers.
events.quote: Sygg was knocked unconscious, Dugah was eaten

events.summary: The Vendilion clique abducts Maralen; Sygg reaches the Bosk with Rhys, Ashling and Brigid.
events.quote: Sygg took the company through the Dark Meanders

events.summary: Brigid attacks Ashling, ensnares Sygg and Rhys in a net, and Sygg frees them with acid.
events.quote: Sygg managed to free them both from the kithkin hero's trap

events.summary: Brigid takes the Crescent of Morningtide as the Great Aurora sweeps the world.
events.quote: unfortunately, Brigid took it as the Great Aurora swept across the world.

events.summary: Sygg helps Maralen and Brigid ambush Ashling; Maralen betrays him and keeps the Crescent.
events.quote: She kept the Crescent and united the power of two greater elementals, fire and water, in herself.

relations.quote: Sygg was an established captain of shapewater ferries along the Wanderwine River with his apprentice, Dugah
she had never planned to give the Crescent back to Sygg and his battered crew.
secretly a creation of the conniving faerie queen Oona
